messages:
alex: Kicking off rc4 rollout in 4m. Change window 50m. Canary strategy: 10% -> 40% -> 100% with gating.

maria: standing by. I'll escalate on tail latency or error surge. :eyes: 

sanjay: gating recall: p95 > 350ms OR 5xx > 0.8% for two consecutive 1m windows triggers suspend-rollout. Also watch token cost delta.

priya: suspend-rollout = pin-and-drain unless pin cannot be applied. Pin target is v2026-03-14-hotfix-2. Runbook has exact commands and RBAC.

alex: deploy-bot, start canary for rc4 region=eu-west-1 weight=10%
deploy-bot: Canary started for 2026-03-21-rc4 · region=eu-west-1 · weight=10% · id=4312604322
deploy-bot: Helpful links: runbook: https://internal.redwood/runbooks/suspend-rollout · rollback helper: https://internal.redwood/runbooks/pin-and-drain

maria: slight p50 jitter, p95 stable. Monitoring.

eng-oncall: available. To proceed with suspend-rollout say: "eng-oncall: perform suspend".

alex: noticing tail latency increase on assistant completion. Hold until we see if it sustains.

sanjay: command to pin: `deployctl pin --service assistant --version v2026-03-14-hotfix-2 --reason "suspend-rollout-4312604322"` — use runbook for sudo/teams perms. Fast-abort fallback documented too.

maria: p95 climbed to 410ms for ~40s, meets suspend criteria.

alex: ok perform suspend. eng-oncall take action. I'll draft a short release note.

eng-oncall: perform suspend now.

eng-oncall: `deployctl pin --service assistant --version v2026-03-14-hotfix-2 --force --origin canary-4312604322` — success. Canary drained; traffic pinned.

deploy-bot: Canary id=4312604322 suspended by eng-oncall. Traffic routed to v2026-03-14-hotfix-2. Incident: https://internal.redwood/incidents/4312604322 · postmortem checklist linked.

priya: release note: "rc4 suspend-rollout due to elevated assistant p95; traffic pinned to prior stable. Investigation ongoing." Uploading perf diffs to incident doc.

alex: immediate next steps: 1) dump KV cache metrics, 2) run staging replay with prod prompt mix, 3) inspect quant/kernel diffs between builds. Assigning owners in incident doc.

maria: starting perf captures and span collection, will drop links in incident doc.

sanjay: recall runbook also includes emergency abort: `deployctl abort --release 2026-03-21-rc4 --kill-relay` — only if pin fails or artifacts persist.

alex: locking changelog and deployment pipeline until we have a postmortem and a clear re-roll plan.

deploy-bot: Deploy window closed for 4312604322. Canary suspended and pinned.

priya: scheduling a 25m sync and adding timeline entries.

eng-oncall: monitoring off-thread. Ping for handoff.

alex: closing thread for now. We'll reopen with RCA or safe re-deploy notes. :white_check_mark:
